# ffxf_region (Data Source)

Looks up an FFXF Cloud region by slug.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ffxf_region" "montreal" {
  slug = "montreal"
}

output "region_status" {
  value = data.ffxf_region.montreal.status
}

output "region_ipv6_available" {
  value = data.ffxf_region.montreal.ipv6
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) Stable region slug, such as montreal.

### Read-Only

- `country` (String) Two-letter country code.
- `ipv4` (Boolean) Whether a public IPv4 address is currently available.
- `ipv6` (Boolean) Whether IPv6 is available.
- `name` (String) Display name of the region.
- `status` (String) Availability status: available, limited, or unavailable.
